verdict.rationale: Lambda's On-Demand Cloud offers GPU VMs that can be launched self-serve and "in minutes," either from the console (Instances page) or through the documented Lambda Cloud REST API with cloud-init. Instances come with Lambda Stack and JupyterLab preinstalled and are reachable over SSH, so code can run right away. A community-built CLI that launches an H100, SSHes in and runs a job independently confirms the API workflow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on measurement of launch-to-ready time, and evidence on capacity availability given the "first-come access" caveat.
